title: CALC-003 — ⁹Be Alpha-Neutron Reaction
body:
# CALC-003 — ⁹Be Alpha-Neutron Reaction

$$
{}^9Be+{}^4He
\rightarrow
{}^{12}C+n
$$

Mass balance:

$$
\Delta m
=
m({}^9Be)+m({}^4He)
-
m({}^{12}C)-m_n
$$

Using:

$$
m({}^9Be)=9.012183065\ u
$$

$$
m({}^4He)=4.00260325413\ u
$$

$$
m({}^{12}C)=12\ u
$$

$$
m_n=1.00866491595\ u
$$

gives:

$$
\boxed{
Q\approx5.702051\ {\rm MeV}
}
$$
